analogy.rationale: DHFR inhibition depletes tetrahydrofolate, blocking thymidylate and purine synthesis, so it phenocopies thymidylate synthase inhibition and other DNA-synthesis blocks; the transcriptional response is moderate because 6-24 h of folate depletion mainly causes cell-cycle/DNA-damage stress rather than a broad immediate program.
